chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadala ibn Ayyub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu al-Jarud, from Hakim ibn Jubayr, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon them both),
regarding the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'And (it is) an announcement from Allah and His Messenger.' He said: The announcement is Ali, peace be upon him.
ai.seo_question: Who is the 'announcement' mentioned in the Quranic verse 'And an announcement from Allah and His Messenger'?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn (Zayn al-Abidin) interprets the 'announcement' (adhan) in Surah At-Tawbah 9:3 as referring specifically to Imam Ali, establishing his unique status as the living embodiment of divine proclamation. This interpretation underscores the Shia concept of the Imam as the authoritative interpreter and bearer of the message, linking the textual revelation to the person of the Ahl al-Bayt. It serves as a foundational evidence for the spiritual and political authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib as the true successor and voice of the Messenger.

en.basel-kadem: 1. My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Hussain bin Sa’eed, from Fadala bin Ayub, from Aban bin Uthman, from Abu’l-Jaroud, from Hukaim bin Jubayr, from Ali bin Hussain, peace be upon them both, with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «And (it is) an announcement from Allah and His Messenger» [9:3].
He said: The announcement was Ali, peace be upon him.
